name: vidmuse
description: VidMuse motion-film plugin for Codex. /vidmuse-recut packages existing speaking footage; /vidmuse-create builds films without source footage; both proactively call /vidmuse-assets to turn full-content semantics into licensed, beat-bound asset plans. /vidmuse-assets owns canonical identity, Core Pack / Creator Library policy, and provider selection; the internal media-use runtime executes generation, downloads, transforms, cache/project freeze, ASR, and word alignment. Shared taste stack (charter, tells, FRAME, gates).

interface.shortDescription: Recut · Create · Reusable asset libraries · Multi-track Timeline
interface.longDescription: VidMuse provides /vidmuse-recut for existing talking-head packaging, /vidmuse-create for script+TTS explainers and website/product promos with no source plate, and /vidmuse-assets for proactive Semantic Asset Passes plus licensed Core Pack, Creator Library, and dynamic-provider sourcing. VidMuse CLI is the single AI media substrate; the internal media-use runtime performs downloads, generation, transforms, project freeze, ASR, and ATA. User preview uses vidmuse serve multi-track DSL.
defaultPrompt: Package this talking-head video with designed graphic overlays
Director-mode recut of my interview into a launch-film motion piece
Make a 60s knowledge explainer from this script with TTS (vidmuse-create)
Make an AI development-history film and source useful model/company marks automatically
Promo film for this website — no talking-head footage (vidmuse-create)
Vox-style paper-collage B-roll for this one VO line (vidmuse-create)
Find the Codex color logo from Lobe Icons and add it to this project's asset library (vidmuse-assets)
